children: MULTICONSULT AND REJLERS TO CREATE A LEADING PAN-NORDIC MULTIDISCIPLINARY CONSULTANCY GROUP THROUGH A MERGER OF EQUALS
COMBINED GROUP WILL HAVE CLOSE TO 8,000 EMPLOYEES
MERGER EXPECTED TO GENERATE COST SYNERGIES OF SEK 100-120 MILLION ANNUALLY WITHIN THREE YEARS
MULTICONSULT REJLERS TO HAVE MARKET CAPITALISATION OF CLOSE TO SEK 8 BILLION
VIKTOR SVENSSON TO BE PRESIDENT AND CEO, KRISTIN O. AUGESTAD TO BE DEPUTY CEO
FULL EFFECTS OF SYNERGIES ARE EXPECTED TO BE REACHED WITHIN THREE YEARS WITH ONE-OFF INTEGRATION COSTS OF ABOUT SEK 40 MILLION
NEW CFO WILL BE RECRUITED AND WILL BE BASED IN OSLO
MULTICONSULT REJLERS WILL BE DUAL LISTED ON NASDAQ STOCKHOLM AND EURONEXT OSLO BØRS
